macros.name: additem
macros.doc: Adds an item to the invoice.

macros.name: setaccountnumber
macros.doc: Specify the bank account for payment.

macros.name: setdeadline
macros.doc: Specify the deadline of the invoice.

macros.name: setinvoicedate
macros.doc: Specify the date of the invoice.

macros.name: setinvoicenumber
macros.doc: Sets the invoice number for the invoice.

macros.name: setinvoicetitle
macros.doc: Overrides the standard title of the invoice.

macros.name: setourref
macros.doc: Specifies your reference to the invoice (usually your own name, but if the invoice is sent by a company, this could be a specific employee).

macros.name: setreceiveraddress
macros.doc: Specifies the address for the receiver of the invoice.

macros.name: setreceivername
macros.doc: Sets the receiver name for the invoice.

macros.name: setsubtotal
macros.doc: Specify the subtotal of all items before VAT is applied.

macros.name: settotal
macros.doc: Specify the total of all items after VAT is applied.

macros.name: setvat
macros.doc: Specify the amount of money given as sales tax for the sale (total).
